name: Vehicle
description: Base class for all Vehicle entities.

functions.name: AddSkeletalMeshAttached
functions.description: Attaches a Skeletal Mesh as master pose to this entity
functions.description_long: Spawns and attaches a SkeletalMesh to this entity, the SkeletalMesh must have the same skeleton used by this Actor's mesh, and will follow all animations from it. Uses a custom ID to be used for removing/customizing it afterwards

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Used further for removing or applying material settings on it

parameters.name: skeletal_mesh_path
parameters.description: Path to SkeletalMesh asset to attach

parameters.name: socket
parameters.description: Bone socket to attach to

parameters.name: relative_location
parameters.description: Relative location

parameters.name: relative_rotation
parameters.description: Relative rotation

parameters.name: use_parent_bounds
parameters.description: If true, this component uses its parents bounds when attached. This can be a significant optimization with many components attached together

parameters.name: use_base_leader_pose_component
parameters.description: If true, this component will use the base leader pose component for copying its animation

parameters.name: animation_path
parameters.description: Path to Animation asset to play on the Skeletal Mesh attached

parameters.name: attachable_id
parameters.description: Optionally attaches this to another attached skeletal mesh (instead of attaching to the root component)

functions.name: AddStaticMeshAttached
functions.description: Attaches a Static Mesh to this entity
functions.description_long: Spawns and attaches a StaticMesh to this Vehicle in a Socket with a relative location and rotation. Uses a custom ID to be used for removing/customizing it afterwards

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique ID to assign to the StaticMesh

parameters.name: static_mesh_path
parameters.description: Path to StaticMesh asset to attach

parameters.name: socket
parameters.description: Bone socket to attach to

parameters.name: relative_location
parameters.description: Relative location

parameters.name: relative_rotation
parameters.description: Relative rotation

parameters.name: use_parent_bounds
parameters.description: If true, this component uses its parents bounds when attached. This can be a significant optimization with many components attached together

parameters.name: attachable_id
parameters.description: Optionally attaches this to another attached static mesh (instead of attaching to the root component)

functions.name: GetAllStaticMeshAttached
functions.description: Gets all Static Meshes attached to this entity

return.description: the key as the Attached ID, and the value as the Asset Path

functions.name: GetAllSkeletalMeshAttached
functions.description: Gets all Skeletal Meshes attached to this entity

return.description: the key as the Attached ID, and the value as the Asset Path

functions.name: RemoveSkeletalMeshAttached
functions.description: Removes, if it exists, a SkeletalMesh from this Vehicle given its custom ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique ID of the SkeletalMesh to remove

functions.name: SetStaticMeshAttachedTransform
functions.description: Sets a Static Mesh Attached location and rotation

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique ID of the StaticMesh set with AddStaticMeshAttached

parameters.name: relative_location
parameters.description: New relative location

parameters.name: relative_rotation
parameters.description: New relative rotation

functions.name: RemoveStaticMeshAttached
functions.description: Removes, if it exists, a StaticMesh from this Vehicle given its custom ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique ID of the StaticMesh to remove

functions.name: RemoveAllStaticMeshesAttached
functions.description: Removes all StaticMeshes attached

functions.name: RemoveAllSkeletalMeshesAttached
functions.description: Removes all SkeletalMeshes attached

functions.name: SetDoor
functions.description: Adds a Door to the Vehicle
functions.description_long: Adds a Door at offset_location from root which will pose the Character at seat_location with seat_rotation rotation.

parameters.name: leave_lateral_offset
parameters.description: It's where the Character will be ejected when leaving it (e.g. -150 for left door or 150 for right door)

functions.name: PlayAnimation
functions.description: Plays an Animation on this Vehicle

parameters.name: loop_indefinitely
parameters.description: This parameter is only used if the Vehicle has an Animation Blueprint

parameters.name: blend_in_time
parameters.description: This parameter is only used if the Vehicle has an Animation Blueprint

parameters.name: blend_out_time
parameters.description: This parameter is only used if the Vehicle has an Animation Blueprint

parameters.name: play_rate
parameters.description: This parameter is only used if the Vehicle has an Animation Blueprint

parameters.name: stop_all_montages
parameters.description: Stops all running Montages from the same Group. This parameter is only used if the Vehicle has an Animation Blueprint

functions.name: StopAnimation
functions.description: Stops an Animation Montage on this Vehicle

parameters.name: animation_asset
parameters.description: Leave empty to stop all Montages

functions.name: GetMesh
functions.description: Gets the Asset name

functions.name: GetDoors
functions.description: Gets all configured Doors

functions.name: GetPassenger
functions.description: Gets a passenger from a seat

return.description: or nil if no passenger in seat
return.name: passenger

functions.name: GetPassengers
functions.description: Gets all passengers

functions.name: SetExplosionSettings
functions.description: Configures the Explosion Settings when health reaches zero

parameters.name: engine_relative_location
parameters.description: Relative location of the Engine. Used to apply particles and effects.

parameters.name: materials_index_burnt_override
parameters.description: List of material indexes to override to burnt when exploded. Leave it empty for all indexes.

parameters.name: materials_index_burnt_invisible
parameters.description: List of material indexes to override to invisible when exploded. Leave it empty for all indexes.

functions.name: IsEngineStarted
functions.description: Checks if the engine is started

functions.name: SetCameraArmLength
functions.description: Sets how far the camera stays from this Vehicle while driving it
functions.description_long:
Sets how far the camera stays from this Vehicle while driving it, in centimeters.

This overrides the Player's own Camera Arm Length for as long as they are driving it. Set it to 0 to use the Player's value instead, which is the default.

parameters.name: arm_length
parameters.description: The distance in centimeters, or 0 to use the Player's own value

functions.name: SetCameraOffset
functions.description: Sets the Vehicle Camera Offset

functions.name: SetAnimationBlueprintPropertyValue
functions.description: Sets an Animation Blueprint Property/Variable value directly
functions.description_long:
Sets an Animation Blueprint Property/Variable value directly on the Animation Blueprint passed in the constructor.

Note: only VehicleWheeled has an Animation Blueprint, on any other Vehicle type this does nothing.

functions.name: GetAnimationBlueprintPropertyValue
functions.description: Gets an Animation Blueprint Property/Variable value directly
functions.description_long:
Gets an Animation Blueprint Property/Variable value directly.

Note: only VehicleWheeled has an Animation Blueprint, on any other Vehicle type this returns nil.

functions.name: CallAnimationBlueprintEvent
functions.description: Calls an Animation Blueprint Event or Function
functions.description_long:
Calls an Animation Blueprint Event or Function
Returns all Function return values on Client Side

Note: only VehicleWheeled has an Animation Blueprint, on any other Vehicle type this does nothing.

parameters.name: event_name
parameters.description: Event or Function name

parameters.name: arguments...
parameters.description: Sequence of arguments to pass to the event

functions.name: BindAnimationBlueprintEventDispatcher
functions.description: Assigns and Binds an Animation Blueprint Event Dispatcher
functions.description_long:
Assigns and Binds an Animation Blueprint Event Dispatcher.

Note: only VehicleWheeled has an Animation Blueprint, on any other Vehicle type this does nothing.

parameters.name: dispatcher_name
parameters.description: Event Dispatcher name

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback function to call

functions.name: UnbindAnimationBlueprintEventDispatcher
functions.description: Unbinds an Animation Blueprint Event Dispatcher

parameters.name: dispatcher_name
parameters.description: Event Dispatcher name

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Optional callback to unbind

functions.name: SetBuoyancyPontoons
functions.description: Sets the Buoyancy Pontoons used by the Water simulation
functions.description_long:
Sets the spherical Pontoons used to float this entity on Water, overriding the ones automatically calculated from the Mesh bounds and mass.

Pass no value (or an empty table) to go back to the automatically calculated ones.

Pontoons only have an effect on Maps with Water Buoyancy enabled

parameters.name: pontoons
parameters.description: Array with the Pontoons, or nil to restore the automatically calculated ones

table_properties.name: Radius
table_properties.description: Radius of the Pontoon sphere, must be greater than 0

functions.name: SetBuoyancySettings
functions.description: Sets how this entity behaves on Water
functions.description_long:
Any value passed as nil restores that setting's default.

While the Pontoons are being automatically calculated, changing buoyancy_coefficient also recalculates them, as their radius derives from it.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether Buoyancy forces are applied at all

parameters.name: buoyancy_coefficient
parameters.description: How much it floats, the higher the more

parameters.name: buoyancy_damp
parameters.description: First order damping on the vertical velocity, reduces bobbing

parameters.name: max_buoyant_force
parameters.description: Clamp on the upwards force, stops light objects being launched out of the water

arguments.name: impact_force
arguments.description: The intensity of the Hit normalized by the Vehicle's weight

arguments.name: impact_location
arguments.description: The world 3D location of the impact

arguments.name: velocity
arguments.description: The Vehicle velocity at the moment it hits

arguments.name: other_actor
arguments.description: The other actor that hit this Vehicle

events.description: Triggered when a Character fully enters the Vehicle

events.name: CharacterLeave
events.description: Triggered when a Character fully leaves the Vehicle

events.description: Triggered when a Character attempts to enter the Vehicle

events.name: CharacterAttemptLeave
events.description: Triggered when a Character attempts to leave the Vehicle
